title: Belief-Guided Decision Making with Uncertainty Gating in the Game of Go
abstract: arXiv:2607.26946v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advancements in Computer Go, driven by AlphaZero and MuZero, rely heavily on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to correct the errors of the neural network policy. While effective on massive computational clusters, this dependence creates a critical bottleneck on consumer-grade hardware, where the computational cost of tree management severely limits inference rates. Furthermore, without deep search, these models suffer from hallucination, proposing moves with high confidence that are strategically fatal. This paper introduces a novel Belief-Guided architecture that disentangles the Policy head from a distinct Belief head. Unlike traditional value functions, the Belief head acts as an internal simulator and independent critic, modeling epistemic uncertainty and strategic stability. translated_title: 围棋中基于不确定性门控的信念引导决策
translated_abstract: 近期计算机围棋的进展在AlphaZero和MuZero的推动下，严重依赖蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）来纠正神经网络策略的错误。虽然这种依赖在大规模计算集群上是有效的，但在消费级硬件上却造成了关键瓶颈，树管理的计算成本严重限制了推理速度。此外，在没有深度搜索的情况下，这些模型会产生幻觉，以高置信度提出在战略上致命的落子。本文提出了一种新颖的信念引导架构，将策略头与独立的信念头解耦。与传统价值函数不同，信念头充当内部模拟器和独立批评者，建模认知不确定性和战略稳定性。通过集成记忆机制（Transformer/GRU）来处理长期依赖和打劫规则，并利用门控机制过滤过度自信的预测……
tldr: 本文提出一种信念引导架构，将策略头与独立的信念头解耦，让信念头作为内部模拟器和独立批评者来建模认知不确定性，并借助门控机制和记忆机制，在围棋中降低对深度搜索的依赖、缓解模型幻觉并提升消费级硬件上的推理效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a belief-guided architecture that decouples the policy head from a distinct belief head acting as an internal simulator and independent critic to model epistemic uncertainty, using gating and memory mechanisms to mitigate hallucination and reduce reliance on deep search in the game of Go.
